By invitation

Help shape the future of executive AI leadership.

The network grows through trust, contribution, and careful curation. Membership begins only through an invitation from an existing member, not through an open application.

A leadership institution, not a transaction.

MOJO AI Summits protects the room by keeping membership relational. Each member has two invitations per month, and the expectation is that members make those invitations with care. Those introductions are part of how contribution is understood, alongside participation, research, mentorship, and leadership.

Fellowship tiers are reviewed and voted on by members at quarterly summit events, so recognition is earned through peer trust and visible contribution.
